title: Changing the Servicing Provider on a Prior Authorization
content:
**Member terms.** Where the Prior Authorization class allows a change of servicing provider, a Prairie Ridge Health Plan member may move an approved authorization to another in-network servicing provider for the same service. The servicing provider is changed only on an authorization in approved status, as shown on the plan's authorization record. In a class that does not allow the change, or to an out-of-network provider, the member may have the approval voided and the new provider submits a new request.

**Retired wording.** The clause "the units left and the end date carry over unchanged" is **no longer in force**. What a change of servicing provider carries over is governed by the plan's current basis for provider changes on approved authorizations.

The class settings this rule reads are whether the class allows a change of servicing provider and whether a new servicing provider must be in network.

## Branches

| Class allows the change | New provider in network | Authorization status | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | approved | the servicing provider may be moved to the new provider for the same service |
| Yes | Yes | any status other than approved | the servicing provider is not changed |
| Yes | No | approved | the member may have the approval voided, and the new provider submits a new request |
| No | Yes or No | approved | the member may have the approval voided, and the new provider submits a new request |

## Hypothetical cases

- A hypothetical member with an approved Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization wants to move to another in-network therapy practice for the same service: the class allows the change, so the approved authorization may be moved.
- A hypothetical member with an approved Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization wants a different surgeon: the class does not allow the change, so the member may have the approval voided and the new surgeon submits a new request.

superseded_clauses: the units left and the end_date carry over unchanged
